newsitem.title: FRANCE: EP plans new body to monitor action on BSE.
newsitem.headline: EP plans new body to monitor action on BSE.

text.p: The European Parliament is to set up a special committee to monitor whether the European Commission is following up its recommendations for improving the handling of the mad cow crisis.

Parliament president Jose Maria Gil-Robles announced on Thursday night that the parliament's political group leaders had agreed to the decision, which is expected to receive formal approval at the April 23-24 plenary session in Brussels.

The committee, which will operate for six months, will verify whether the Commission is fulfilling its promises to carry out a series of reforms demanded by Euro-MPs in February after a 12-month inquiry into the handling of the BSE (bovine spongiform encephalopathy) epidemic.

Parliament is threatening to sack the entire Commission in December if it does not introduce the reforms, which include changes to internal management structures and improved food safety policy, by the end of the year.
